abilities.name: Dragon Aura
abilities.text: As long as Rayquaza has any basic Fire Energy cards and any basic Lightning Energy cards attached to it, prevent all effects, except damage, by an opponent's attack done to Rayquaza.

attacks.name: Tumbling Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage.

attacks.name: Aqua Wave
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage.

abilities.name: Natural Cure
abilities.text: When you attach a Water Energy card from your hand to Lombre, remove all Special Conditions from Lombre.

abilities.name: Happy Dance
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may remove 1 damage counter from each of your Pokémon. You can't use more than 1 Happy Dance Poké-Power each turn. This power can't be used if Ludicolo is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Water Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Water Energy attached to Ludicolo. This attack does 40 damage plus 20 more damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Recharge
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Lightning Energy card and attach it to Electrike. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage.

attacks.name: Thunder Spear
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Magnetic Tackle
attacks.text: You may do 40 damage plus 10 more damage for each Lightning Energy attached to Manectric. If you do, Manectric does 10 damage to itself.

abilities.name: Dense
abilities.text: Any damage done to Numel by attacks from Evolved Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Back Burner
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for up to 2 basic Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Split Bomb
attacks.text: Choose 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to each of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Fly
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, prevent all effects of an attack, including damage, done to Taillow during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Mid-air Crush
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent discards 1 Energy card, if any, attached to that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Nosedive
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Swellow does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Supersonic
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.name: Lady Outing
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.
Search your deck for up to 3 different types of basic Energy cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Master Ball
rules: Look at the top 7 cards from your deck. Choose a Basic Pokémon or Evolution card from those cards, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Put the other 6 cards back on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Strength Charm
rules: Attach Strength Charm to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. If that Pokémon is Knocked Out, discard this card.

Whenever an attack from the Pokémon that Strength Charm is attached to does damage to the Active Pokémon, the attack does 10 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance). Discard Strength Charm at the end of the turn in which this Pokémon attacks.

cards.name: Switch
rules: Switch 1 of your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.name: Potion
rules: Remove 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon (remove 1 damage counter if that Pokémon has only 1).
